Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The redhat-access-plugin-ipa package contains the Red Hat Access Identity
Management (IdM) plug-in. The plug-in provides web-based access to various Red
Hat subscription services, including Knowledgebase solutions, support cases, and
others. The package integrates the modular Red Hat Access Angular UI framework
into the IdM web UI.

This enhancement update adds the redhat-access-plugin-ipa package to Red Hat
Enterprise Linux 7. (BZ#1120262)

All users who require redhat-access-plugin-ipa are advised to install this new
package.
